items.title: Garmin (GRMN) Is Buying TrainingPeaks And TrainHeroic While Launching CIRQA
items.summary: Garmin (NYSE:GRMN) has acquired TrainingPeaks and TrainHeroic, two leading digital fitness platforms for endurance and strength athletes. The company has also launched the CIRQA Smart Band, a subscription free, screen free fitness tracker focused on discreet health and fitness monitoring. These moves expand Garmin's position across both software and hardware in the fitness and wellness market.
